devices.lead: Plugs and bulbs speaking KLAP on your LAN. More models land with every release.

faq.a1html: No. Control, discovery and authentication all happen on your LAN via the KLAP protocol. Once paired, you can unplug your WAN and everything keeps working. Zero egress, by design.
faq.a2html: Verified today: plugs P100, P110 (with energy monitoring) and bulbs L510, L520, L610, L630 (brightness, temperature and color where hardware allows). Support expands with each release.
faq.a3html: Never. No accounts on our side, no analytics, no telemetry. Energy history, schedules and credentials stay on your device, and backups are files you own and can export or delete at any time.
faq.a4html: Add several Tapo accounts to split homes, rentals or family setups, then export your whole configuration to a single file. Moving phones? Import it and every device, room and schedule is back in seconds.
faq.a5html: Only for the first sync. Afterwards your watch mirrors device state and sends LAN commands directly over Wi-Fi, so a quick toggle from your wrist works even if your phone is in another room.

features.f1d: State mirrors in real time between Android and Wear OS. Toggle on one, both agree in milliseconds.
features.f2d: Automatic subnet discovery finds every Tapo device on your LAN and pairs with a local handshake.
features.f3d: Dim, change temperature and color on supported bulbs with a buttery slider — applied instantly.
features.f4d: Live wattage, daily and historical consumption from the P110 — stored on-device, never uploaded.
features.f5d: Arrive home, lights on. Leave, everything off. Boundaries evaluated on your phone — not in a cloud.
features.f6d: Multiple Tapo accounts, multiple homes. Export and restore your full setup in one encrypted file.
features.lead: Six capabilities that make Otapo the fastest way to drive Tapo gear — all offline-capable.
